title: spring.lock
description: Two buckets: spring.lock.default holds family-wide values (each overridable per instance), spring.lock.instances.<name> holds one entry per named instance. No other key belongs directly under spring.lock.

instances.description: One entry per instance; the key is the bean name, and any name is legal.

enabled.description: Wrap the Locker with the observe-lock adapter; false = bare locker
